answer_1.quote: In this paper, we focus on abstractive summarization of legal documents, with the main objective to produce enriched, useful, and factual summaries ...

answer_2.quote: We report the well-known ROUGE-L and BLEU metrics. We also use 3 contextual metrics: Bert-Score which compares contextual embeddings of sentences, FactCC which assesses the factual consistency of the generated summaries using textual entailment, and QuestEval, a question generation and answering metric. ... We also use entity-level metrics: Coverage (Recall, Precision), Faithfulness, Factual hallucination rate, Non-factual hallucination rate.

answer_4.quote: We were unable to provide a human evaluation of our approach. Since legal language is particularly complex, collaboration with legal experts is necessary. ... we were not able to evaluate a significant number of generated summaries in order to present the results of this evaluation.
